Deg.reason: Deg denotes a graph-based uncertainty baseline using the degree matrix, not a human language; this is a false positive.

Chinese.reason: Chinese refers to a language evaluated through Mandarin Chinese SciQ examples, rephrasing prompts, and human assessment, so it is studied.

English.reason: English refers to a human language used in the multilingual SciQ experiments, prompting, and rephrasing evaluation, so it is studied.

French.reason: French refers to a human language evaluated on multilingual SciQ, rephrasing prompts, and human judgments, so it is studied.

Japanese.reason: Japanese refers to a human language evaluated on multilingual SciQ, rephrasing prompts, and human judgments, so it is studied.
